# GitHub Actions Configuration

This directory contains the GitHub Actions workflows for the awesome-gaussian-slam repository.

## Workflows

- `awesome-list.yml`: Main CI workflow that validates the awesome list structure, checks links, and validates formatting.

## Configuration Files

- `.markdownlint.json`: Configuration for markdown linting
- `.mlc_config.json`: Configuration for markdown link checking
- `.lycheeignore`: Configuration for lychee link checker (if used)
